description: This file is a shell script for testing a Git post-rewrite hook, including setup, various test cases for Git operations like commit amend, rebase, and interactive rebase, and verifying hook inputs.

methods.name: clear_hook_input
methods.description: Removes hook input data files to reset the environment before tests.

methods.name: verify_hook_input
methods.description: Compares current hook input data files with expected data.

methods.name: test_fail_interactive_rebase
methods.description: Runs an interactive rebase with specified fake input lines, expecting failure.
